fn example() {
    for shared in [files, locked] {
        let index = shared.iter().find(|file| file.path == "index.html").unwrap();
        let html = std::str::from_utf8(&index.bytes).unwrap();
        let declaration = "<link rel=\"icon\" type=\"image/png\" sizes=\"32x32\" href=\"favicon.png\">";
        let icon = shared.iter().find(|file| file.path == "favicon.png").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(icon.content_type, "image/png");
        assert_eq!(icon.bytes, include_bytes!("../../../public/favicon-32.png"));
        assert!(html.find(declaration).unwrap() < html.find("</head>").unwrap());
        assert!(!html.contains("href=\"/favicon"));
    }
}
